notes.title: I completed update on English.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41317518/c657cc45416f7a70a557ba0335babb5767acb978.png[/img]

Good day, everyone!
Thank you for playing my humble game.

I updated add English translation.
I was helped by "ChairSupp0rt" for English translation.
But I did translation some parts.
So my translation may wrong.
If you will find wrong English, please teach me.

Next update is correcting a translation for Japanese.
I am not a Japanese, so my Japanese is not perfect.
So I was helped by "hunex".
Hunex gave me really good translation data.
I will update next time verison v1.11.

I want to make network mode in my game.
But I don't have skill about networks.
So I am finding that, but it is difficult for me.
Anyway, I will do my best!
Someday I will be able to add network mode.
Maybe... ^-^

Thank you, everyone. I wish you good luck~
